cues.text: Junpei, on his own, walks across a paved square lined with stone columns and flower beds.
He stops, checks his phone, then puts it away and stands with a hand on his hip.
Nearby, a girl in a long, frilly dress sits on a bench by a flower bed, drawing on a board propped in her lap.
Junpei walks over and stands right in front of her, looking from her to the board.
Junpei walks off across the square, leaving her drawing on the bench.
